An '''adept''' was a member of a [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] group on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] who performed certain arcane duties. The [[Korga]] Duloks employed individuals of this vocation.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide]]''</ref>
